summary.zh-Hans: 腾讯 AI 语音输入，说完即成稿
summary.en: Tencent AI voice input — speak, get a finished draft

reason.zh-Hans: 腾讯推出的 AI 原生语音输入工具（也称「元宝输入法」）。不只是把话转成文字，还会自动去掉口头语、理顺逻辑、润色措辞，直接给出可用的邮件或汇报。内置会议纪要、工作汇报、邮件润色、营销文案等六套场景技能。按住说话、松开即完成转写。目前为邀请码内测。
reason.en: A Tencent AI-native voice input tool (also called "Yuanbao IME"). Beyond transcription it strips filler words, tidies logic and polishes wording into a usable draft. Ships six scenario skills (meeting notes, status reports, email polish, marketing copy, etc.). Hold to talk, release to finish. Currently invite-only beta.

compatibility.zh-Hans: Windows / macOS 桌面端，需邀请码登录。与自由麦搭配：把它的语音快捷键设为遥控器语音键即可。
compatibility.en: Windows / macOS desktop, invite code required. With FreeSay: set its voice hotkey to the remote voice key.
